Test vectors for the Chroma and Heck tests (tests/chroma_lights_test.gd, chroma_maps_test.gd,
chroma_env_test.gd). Generated by the research's
`vectors/gen_vectors.py`, which restates the formulas of Chroma and Heck
(github.com/Aeroluna/Heck at 3bbcaf6733f6faa688a70b296b4d83c92c1f5dc8, MIT), Unity's colour maths
(UnityCsReference, behaviour only) and the base game's event-box filters as ChroMapper and the BSMG
wiki describe them (formulas only), and checks them against closed forms and the published examples.
Each file names its sources in its `source` key. Values are doubles; the game runs in single
precision, so compare with a tolerance of about 1e-5.
